version: Mira model roster v6 - adds M05 true age metadata with prompt-safe visual ages
public_rule: Do not publish model names or model IDs. These profiles are internal production controls for consistent outfit imagery across age cohorts.
assignment_rule: M01, M02, M03, M04, and M05 represent fixed internal model identities, not fixed outfit occasions. Any weekly trend can be styled for work, weekend, date, travel, rainy day, or casual use with any model when the content plan calls for it.
age_prompt_policy: True ages are roster metadata only. Image prompts must use prompt_age_language and visual_profile, never the numeric true_age. Express age through styling and presence, NOT wrinkles. East Asian women look significantly younger than Western age norms. Skin is smooth and well-maintained.

profiles.reader_projection: A young adult reader who wants clean daily outfits that are current, approachable, and easy to adapt without feeling childish.
profiles.fixed_hair_baseline: jaw-length dark brown bob with natural movement
profiles.visual_profile: East Asian woman with an early-20s youthful adult look, fresh soft cheeks, a lighter jawline, natural warm skin with visible human texture, jaw-length dark brown bob with natural movement, approachable practical expression, petite-to-medium healthy proportions, clean casual polish.
profiles.style_range: T-shirts, denim, relaxed shirts, light outerwear, simple dresses, skirts, sneakers, flat sandals, loafers, canvas or nylon bags, clean budget-friendly pieces, casual work basics.
profiles.daily_scenes: neighborhood street, convenience-store corner, covered sidewalk, casual cafe, rainy MRT exit, bookstore street, simple studio with natural shadows.
profiles.avoid: teen styling, childlike styling, school-uniform look, over-cute idol styling, athleisure brand-ad look, streetwear hype styling, luxury bag focus, exaggerated pose, obvious AI smoothness, wrinkle-based age cues
